description: Complete main-tail EC_CODE allocation/reuse, successful release and process-retirement order through the client.dll failure. Handles identify returned allocations, so replay must free the counterfactual returned handle. Requested is the successful NtAllocateVirtualMemoryEx request; original_requested preserves the FEX 128 MiB generation request before halving. Recorded addresses identify baseline geometry only. The five keep-large lines preserve 16 MiB carves for future code buffers rather than grant them to 16 KiB dispatchers.
clock_note: seconds preserve integer wall-clock seconds from the most recent bounded xp timestamp, relative to 03:31:08, including the offset from relative runtime. Before the first xp timestamp, zero is used; no reuse-grace decision depends on that initial ambiguity. Clock strings are lower bounds, not exact event timestamps.
head_note: Head values follow the largest actual allocation endpoint or explicit bump/fresh-tail snapshot so far. For image projections, subtract the recorded data-align delta from the logged used endpoint, which otherwise overstates the allocation endpoint by that delta. Final head is the exact failure census.
projection_note: Image rows reproduce the captured allocation sizes and placement history. They do not assert that every row advances the bump pointer: successful image reuse and rebuilds can remain below the current head. No synthetic image extents are recorded here.
